# Lantern of Revealing

Every property set, and a list in the body.

```cardsmith
card:
  system: simple
  card-type: simple
  language: en
data:
  name: "Lantern of Revealing"
  content: |
    A hooded lantern that, once per day, sheds **bright light** and reveals
    what is *hidden* — invisible creatures and illusions alike.

    - Radius: 30 ft
    - Duration: 1 minute
  reference: "Core Rules, p. 152"
  game-name: "Chronicles of the Ember Coast"
```
